title: Row-major flat index
hints: Row-major means a whole row is stored before the next row starts.
Each row before row `i` takes up `C` slots. How many slots come before `m[i][j]`?
explain: Rows `0` to `i - 1` fill `i * C` slots, and `j` more slots get you to column `j` in row `i`, so the position is `i * C + j`. The number of rows `R` never appears: only the row length matters.
